# Ree

> Ree makes handmade crochet bags, made to order by hand. Orders are taken through Instagram messages.

## Facts
- Brand: Ree
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/byree.eg (@byree.eg)
- Each bag is handmade after the order, about 2 weeks.
- Payment: 20% deposit by InstaPay before making.
- Custom-made bags are available, made to the customer's own design.
- Language of the site: Arabic (Egyptian).

## Pages
- https://byree-eg.github.io/ : the store page with the collection, videos, FAQ and how to order
